name: counter-app
description: Single installed app for the counter PC: embeds the relay (phone <-> counter bridge + PWA static hosting) and the printer service in one Electron process. Persists orders to SQLite, prints kitchen tickets via Electron's native print pipeline. Runs hidden, auto-starts at sign-in and relaunches within seconds of any crash/exit (see src/watchdog.js). Distributed to the counter PC as a packaged installer (electron-builder), not via git — see CLAUDE.md.
